caption:
You did everything the movies told you. That's exactly why it failed.
Humans still run on ancient instincts. Biology didn't watch your romance films.
Pop culture trained you to be passive and put her on a pedestal.
The pedestal is the opposite of what creates attraction.
Her behavior isn't personal. It's evolutionary strategy. Read the map, stop taking it as an insult.
Send this to a man still running the script.
